restore_procedure: READ-ONLY SNAPSHOT. It is a comparison baseline, not an automatic restore.
VAL-018 check: re-capture with this script and diff the 'automations' list. Every automation whose state was 'on' here must still be 'on', and none may have vanished.
Name/area drift: diff device_registry[].name_by_user and .area_id. Revert any unintended change through HARegistryWriter (libs/homeiq-ha/src/homeiq_ha/registry_writer.py), never by raw WS write.

Automation config rollback: HA keeps automations in config/automations.yaml on the HA host; restore an individual automation by id via the HA UI or by re-POSTing its saved config to /api/config/automation/config/<id>.
Entity slugs: this loop never sends new_entity_id, so entity_id slugs cannot move. A changed slug means something outside this loop did it.
